summary.text: Edwin Munoz is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 30, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican incumbent Chase Tramont.

A project coordinator and University of Central Florida graduate, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is focused on affordability, family support, public schools, and making government processes easier to navigate.

paragraphs.text: Munoz earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Central Florida, which he described in a Ballotpedia survey as a B.A. in Political Science.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a project coordinator.
In the survey, Munoz said he has spent his career helping developers, contractors, and homeowners get through permits and approvals.
He said family and opportunity shaped his commitment to public service, citing an aunt who raised her children on her own and a grandfather who relies on Social Security.
He listed affordability and wages, childcare and paid leave, strong public schools, and practical approaches to housing and infrastructure as his policy interests.
